bio.text: Andy Biggs was first elected to represent Arizona's Fifth District in 2016, and served as Chairman of the House Freedom Caucus from 2019 through 2021.
Before Congress he served eight years in the Arizona House of Representatives and six years in the Arizona State Senate, where he was elected Senate President in 2012.
He received a B.A. from Brigham Young University, a J.D. from the University of Arizona, and an M.A. in political science from Arizona State University.
An Arizona native, he has lived in Gilbert with his wife, Cindy, for over 35 years.
